about: Kata videos linked from the RFEJYDA dan programme that this reference cannot yet hold. The programme is a hyperlinked document: 122 distinct videos sit behind its technique names, and 110 of them are already indexed here against the technique they demonstrate, which is what storing a video as a platform and an id rather than as a URL is for - the same video arrives as youtu.be/X?si=... and as watch?v=X and is recognised as one. Of the twelve that were new, three are the Kodokan's own English-language kata recordings (Nage-no-Kata, Kime-no-Kata and Ju-no-Kata) and are already recorded in kodokan-unlinked.json, so they are not repeated here. These are the other nine. Every one of them is a kata, and kata is the collection this reference does not have yet, so they attach to nothing. Nothing here is published on the site.
source: Contenidos de los programas de 1º a 6º Dan de Judo (RFEJYDA, October 2025), link annotations
